name: 牛奶水润轻盈泵压身体乳款
description: 牛奶主题轻薄身体乳，浴后涂抹易吸收，层层水润不黏腻

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, blush-pink #F3D6CE and terracotta-rose #E8A38E panels for info and scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with generous fill, soft contact shadows, gentle milky highlight on the bottle
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte blush pedestal block #EBBFAF and neutral cream board #FFF7F0
styleLock.iconSystem: thin rounded icons in the single terracotta accent #C77B62
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright bottle posture with chrome pump visible; hero angle stays a slight 3/4 across benefit and CTA shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft milky body-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, blush pink #F3D6CE, terracotta-rose accent #C77B62 and warm grey text #3A3430; bright soft warm studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin rounded icon style in one accent color; clean high-end body-care photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product posture and consistent hero scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清瓶型与泵头，干净合规赢点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, the pump bottle standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pump bottle standing upright, photographed straight-on at eye-level, full product visible including the pump head. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle on the surface. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial body-care e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no milk splash, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no colored background tint.

shots.intent: 用水润奶溅视觉一秒传达轻盈保湿的核心利益
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, bottle centered on a matte blush pedestal
shots.lighting: soft warm front-left key with a gentle rim on the chrome pump, soft contact shadow
shots.background: blush pink gradient wall #F3D6CE with a sculptural milk splash behind the bottle
shots.props: one sculptural milk splash and a few floating milk droplets, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper left third for the headline copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a matte blush pedestal, one sculptural milk splash blooming behind it with a few floating droplets, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background blush pink gradient #F3D6CE, soft warm front-left key light with a gentle rim highlight on the chrome pump and a soft contact shadow. Generous negative space in the upper left third for the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and a small accent badge 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy claims, no face, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大浴后干燥紧绷的痛点，转向滋润后的舒适状态
shots.camera: matched two-panel split screen, each panel photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at an arm segment
shots.lighting: left panel flat and slightly dull; right panel soft warm and luminous
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the two states carry the contrast
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical framing and lighting logic. Left panel: a generic arm segment with visibly dry, tight, dull skin under flat heavy light, conveying post-shower dryness. Right panel: the same arm segment looking smooth and comfortably hydrated after applying {product}, with the bottle resting beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each panel photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, cropped below the shoulder, no face. Background terracotta-rose #E8A38E on both panels. The product occupies 40-50% in the right panel. Negative: no real model face, no exaggerated or fabricated skin results, no diseased or wounded skin, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入浴后全身护理的真实场景，触发自我投射
shots.camera: eye-level candid framing from behind the model, showing her back and arms only, neck-down crop
shots.lighting: soft warm bathroom window light from the left, 5200K, gentle steam haze, soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm blush bathroom #F6EFEA with a matte cream counter #FFF7F0
shots.props: a folded towel and the {product} bottle held at arm's length applying lotion to her own shoulder
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the scene is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generic female model seen from behind, neck-down crop with no recognizable face, applying the lotion from {product} to her own shoulder and arm after a shower. Photographed at eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Soft warm bathroom window light from the left at 5200K with gentle steam haze and soft shadows. Background warm blush bathroom #F6EFEA, matte cream counter #FFF7F0, a folded towel as the only extra prop. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no recognizable face, no front view of the model, no hands covering the pump label, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered bathroom clutter.

shots.intent: 用乳液挤出的质地特写证明轻薄水润易推开
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro of the lotion texture, tight zoom with shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft skimming side light from the right revealing the glossy milky texture, controlled highlight
shots.props: a small swatch of lotion on the board
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a silky milky lotion texture from {product}, a smooth swatch spread on a cream board, tight zoom with shallow depth of field and the foreground edge sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft skimming side light from the right revealing the glossy hydrating texture with a controlled highlight. Neutral cream board background #FFF7F0. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking fake cream, no water droplets, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands or fingers in frame.

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow

shots.props: one rounded soft-white #FFFFFF info card with empty ruled lines
shots.whitespace: balanced margins around the card for structured copy
shots.textZone: right-side card zone with structured label rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce product-information infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the bottle upright beside a rounded soft-white info card. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. shots.intent: 以干净克制的呈现降低决策风险，不虚构任何背书

shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF with one thin empty seal-outline frame as a blank proof placeholder
shots.props: one empty outline seal frame and one blank label line, both unfilled

Background pure white #FFFFFF with a single thin empty seal-outline frame and one blank label line as unfilled proof placeholders, generous negative space on the right 40% for the trust copy 「{selling_point_2}」. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle matching the benefit shot, bottle centered with a soft milk splash echo
shots.lighting: punchier soft warm studio light, gentle rim on the chrome pump, soft contact shadow
shots.background: terracotta-rose gradient #E8A38E with a subtle milk wave at the bottom edge
shots.props: one soft milk wave graphic and an empty rounded CTA button shape

shots.textZone: upper headline zone plus empty CTA button

The bottle at a slight 3/4 hero angle centered on a terracotta-rose gradient background #E8A38E with a subtle soft milk wave along the bottom edge and an empty rounded CTA button shape below the copy zone. Punchier soft warm studio light with a gentle rim on the chrome pump and a soft contact shadow. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：panel-01 主视觉为粉瓶银泵身体乳置于粉色展台、奶花飞溅、标题为牛奶滋润身体乳一抹水润；panel-02 四宫格卖点（清爽不腻/滋润补水/焕亮肌肤/平滑紧致）与「击退干燥 层层滋润」成分宣称横幅；panel-03 奶花环绕卖点气泡（深层滋润/肌肤平衡/强韧角质/锁水保湿）及模特面部使用画面；panel-04 手臂/腿部特写圆窗与「水润保湿 质地轻薄」成分卡片（角鲨烷/优选牛奶/美白烟酰胺）；panel-05 产品信息表（品名牛奶倍润身体乳、容量60ml、浴后均匀涂抹至全身、成分、产地、保质期3年）；panel-06 深层滋润文案板与会员加入角标及二维码。品类判定：产品信息表明确品名为身体乳、使用方法为浴后均匀涂抹至全身、卖点气泡提及美背/手臂/腿部等身体部位，硬证据指向身体乳，故判护肤个护/身体护理而非按源夹名的洗护推洗护发；已剥离内容：原品名字样、二维码、会员促销角标、模特面容（场景镜改为背影颈部以下）、原文案原句、全部规格数值（60ml 容量、3年保质期、产地）与成分宣称（含美白烟酰胺等功效断言一律以占位符替代）、trust 镜仅留空白证明占位。源页自相矛盾：panel-01 品名作「牛奶滋润」而 panel-05 作「牛奶倍润」，两种说法均未作为事实写入；panel-02/04 的美白功效宣称与 panel-02 的清爽不腻定位存在倾向冲突，相关断言均未写入。
